verses.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ مَّيْلِى لِغَيْرِ رِضَى
verses.transcription: ahuuzu bil laahi min maylii lighayri ridaa

verses.text: وَمِنْ صُدُودِىَ عَمَّا سُنَّ أَوْ فُرِضَا
verses.transcription: wa min suduudiya hammaa sunna aw furidaa

verses.text: عَلَىَّ كَوْنِىَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: halayya kawniya habdal laahi fii abadin

verses.text: مَعَ الْكِتَابِ الَّذِى مَنْ رَّدَّهُ قُرِضَا
verses.transcription: mahal kitaabil lazii man raddahu quridaa

verses.text: وَسِيلَتِى عَبْدَهُ الْمُخْتَارُ سَيِّدُنَا
verses.transcription: wasiilatii habdahul mukhtaaru sayyidunaa

verses.text: وَهْوَ الَّذِى مَنْ أَبَى تَغْدِيمَهُ خُفِضَا
verses.transcription: wahwal lazii man abaa taghdiimahu khufidaa

verses.text: ذَاكَ الشَّفِيعُ الَّذِى أَرْجُو شَفَاعَتَهُ
verses.transcription: zaakash shafiihul lazii arjuu shafaahatahu

verses.text: دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى وَلَآ أَبْغِى بِهِ عِوَضَا
verses.transcription: dunyaa wa ukhraa walaa abghii bihi hiwadaa

verses.text: بَايَعْتُهُ بِفُؤَادِى حِيرَ لَمْ تَرَهُ
verses.transcription: baayahtuhu bifu-aadii hiira lam tarahu

verses.text: عَيْنِى وَأَخْدِمُهُ لِلَّهِ مُفْتَرِضَا
verses.transcription: haynii wa akhdimuhu lil laahi muftaridaa

verses.text: أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِى لِرَبِّى بِالنَّبِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: aslamtu wajhii lirabbii bin nabii abadan

verses.text: مَعَ الْكِتَابِ الَّذِى قَدْ سَاقَ لِى الْغَرَضَا
verses.transcription: mahal kitaabil lazii qad saaqa lil gharadaa

verses.text: لِلَّهِ كُلِّيَّتِى عَبْدًا لَّهُ أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: lil laahi kulliyyatii habdan lahu abadan

verses.text: وَلَآ أُطَاوِعُ مَنْ قَدْ جَارَ أَوْرَفَضَا
verses.transcription: walaa utaawihu man qad jaara aw rafadaa

verses.text: لِلَّهِ قَدْ تُّبْتُ فِى ذَا الْيَوْمِ بِدَعِى
verses.transcription: lil laahi qad tubtu fii zal yawmi bidahii

verses.text: وَكُلِّ عَهْدٍ لِأَجْلِ الشَّكِّ قَدْ نُقِضَا
verses.transcription: wa kulli hahdin li-ajlish shakki qad nuqidaa

verses.text: هُوَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ لِى وَحَمَى
verses.transcription: huwal hafiizul lazii qad kaana lii wa hamaa

verses.text: كُلِّى وَأَذْهَبْ عَنِّى الْكَرْبَ وَالْمَرَضَا
verses.transcription: kulii wa azhab hannil karba wal maradaa

verses.text: مَحَوْتَ أَنْ يَّقْصِدَ الْشَّيْطَانُ فِى أَبِدٍ
verses.transcription: mahawta an yaqsidash shaytaanu fii abadin

verses.text: إِلَى جِهَاتِى فَعَهْدِ لَيْسَ مُنْتَقِضَا
verses.transcription: ilaa jihaatii fahahdi laysa muntaqidaa

verses.text: نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ فِى سِرِّ وَفِى عَلَنٍ
verses.transcription: nahuuzu bil laahi fii sirri wa fii halanin

verses.text: مِنْ شَرِّ إِبْلِيسَ حَيْثُ أَنْغَضَّ أَوْرَكَضَا
verses.transcription: min sharri ibliisa haysu anghadda aw rakadaa

verses.text: إِجْعَلْ بِحِفْظِكَ لِى حِضًا يَغِى ضَرَرًا
verses.transcription: ijhal bihifzika lii hidan yaghii dararan

verses.text: يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ كَفَّ وَاقْبَضْ عَنِّىَ الْفَضَضَا
verses.transcription: yaa khayra man kaffa waqbad hanniyal fadadaa

verses.text: شَكَوْتُ حَالِى إِلَيْكَ الْيَوْمَ مُرْتَجِيًا
verses.transcription: shakawtu haalii ilaykal yawma murtajiyan

verses.text: أَرْتَغْهَرَ الدَّهْرَ لِى مَنْ قَلْبُهُ مَرِضَا
verses.transcription: artagh-harad dahra lii man qalbuhu maridaa

verses.text: شَكِّى وَوَسْوَسَتِى عَنْ قَلْبِىَ انْصَرَفَا
verses.transcription: shakkii wa waswasatii han qalbiyan sarafaa

verses.text: فَكَمِّلَنِّىَ وَلْتُصْلِحْ لِىَ الرَّبَضَا
verses.transcription: fakammilanniya waltuslih liyar rabadaa

verses.text: يَؤُمُّنِى قِتْلُنَآ إِبْلِيسُ ذَا حِيَلٍ
verses.transcription: ya-ummunii qitlunaa ibliisu zaa hiyalin

verses.text: وَأَنْتَ رَبِّى وَلِيِّى فَاكْفِنِى الْحَرَضَا
verses.transcription: wa anta rabbii wa liyyii fakfinil haradaa

verses.text: طَيِّبْ نَّقَآءِى بِأَمْنٍ وَالسَّلَامَةِ مِنْ
verses.transcription: tayyib naqaa-ii bi-amnin was salaamati min

verses.text: إِبْلِيسَ وَلْتَكْفِنِيهِ الدَّهْرَ إِرْنَّهَضَا
verses.transcription: ibliisa waltakfiniihid dahra irnnahadaa

verses.text: أُطْرُدُهُ عَنِّىَ يَارَبِّى وَمَا مَعَهُ
verses.transcription: utruduhu hanniya yaa rabbii wa maa mahahu

verses.text: دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى بِتَخْيِيبٍ مَّتِى عَرَضَا
verses.transcription: dunyaa wa ukhraa bitakh-yiibin matii haradaa

verses.text: نَظِّفْ فُّؤَادِى مِنَ الْأَغْيَارِ ذَا وَرَعٍ
verses.transcription: nazzif fu-aadii minal agh-yaari zaa warahin

verses.text: يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ رَّيْزَ قَلْبِى بِالْهُدَى رَحَضَا
verses.transcription: yaa khayra man rayza qalbii bil hudaa rahadaa

verses.text: اصْرِفْ جَمِيعَ الْأَعَادِى بِالنَّبِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: isrif jamiihal ahaadii bin nabii abadan

verses.text: عَنِّى بِتَسْخِيرِهِمْ يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ خَفَضَا
verses.transcription: hannii bitaskhiirihim yaa khayra man khafadaa

verses.text: لَكَ الْخَزَآئِنُ فَافْتَحْ لِى وَزِدْ بُشَرِى
verses.transcription: lakal khazaa-inu faftah lii wazid busharii

verses.text: وَلْتَكْفِنِى كُلَّ مَنْ يَّاتِى لِيَعْتَرِضَا
verses.transcription: waltakfinii kulla man yaatii liyahtaridaa

verses.text: رَجَوْتُ صَرْفَكَ عَنِّى كُلَّ مَفْسَدَةٍ
verses.transcription: rajawtu sarfaka hannii kulla mafsadatin

verses.text: حَقِّوْ رَجَآءِى وَلِى اكْشِفْ سِرَّ مَاغَمُضَا
verses.transcription: haqqiw rajaa-ii wa lik shif sirra maa ghamudaa

verses.text: جِسْمِى وَأَهْلِ وَأَوْلَادِى لَكُمْ أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: jismii wa ahli wa awlaadii lakum abadan

verses.text: وَدِيعَةً فَاكْفِنَا الدَّارَيْنِ سُوءَ قَضَا
verses.transcription: wa diihatan fakfinad daarayni suu-a qadaa

verses.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ الْأَمْرُ كُنْ لِّى وَاحْمِنِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: yaa man lahul amru kun lii wahminii abadan

verses.text: وَصَلِّ دَاْبًا عَلَى مَنْ حُبُّهُ فُرِضَا
verses.transcription: wa salli da-ban halaa man hubbuhu furidaa

verses.text: مُحَمَّدٍ ثُمَّ سَلِّمِ مَّعْ جَمَاعَتِهِ
verses.transcription: muhammadin summa sallimi mah jamaahatihi

verses.text: وَاجْعَلْ بِهِ كُلَّ مَا مِنِّى يَجِىءُ رِضَى
verses.transcription: wajhal bihi kulla maa minnii yajii-u ridaa

bayts.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ مَّيْلِى لِغَيْرِ رِضَى ۞ وَمِنْ صُدُودِىَ عَمَّا سُنَّ أَوْ فُرِضَا

translations.it.karamati: Cerco rifugio in Allah dal mio inclinare verso ciò che non è (il Suo) compiacimento, e dal mio distogliermi da ciò che è stato stabilito come Sunna o prescritto come obbligo.
translations.en.karamati: I seek refuge in God from my inclining towards what is not (His) good pleasure, and from my turning away from what has been laid down as Sunna or prescribed as duty.
translations.fr.karamati: Je cherche refuge en Dieu contre mon penchant pour ce qui n'est pas (Son) agrément, et contre mon détournement de ce qui a été institué en Sunna ou prescrit en obligation.

bayts.text: عَلَىَّ كَوْنِىَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ فِى أَبَدٍ ۞ مَعَ الْكِتَابِ الَّذِى مَنْ رَّدَّهُ قُرِضَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi incombe d'essere servo di Allah per sempre, insieme al Libro (il Corano): chi lo respinge viene reciso (dalla grazia).
translations.en.karamati: It is incumbent upon me to be God's servant forever, together with the Book (the Qur'an): whoever rejects it is cut off (from grace).
translations.fr.karamati: Il m'incombe d'être serviteur de Dieu à jamais, avec le Livre (le Coran) : qui le rejette est retranché (de la grâce).

bayts.text: وَسِيلَتِى عَبْدَهُ الْمُخْتَارُ سَيِّدُنَا ۞ وَهْوَ الَّذِى مَنْ أَبَى تَغْدِيمَهُ خُفِضَا

translations.it.karamati: Il mio tramite è il Suo servo, l'Eletto (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), nostro signore: è colui per il quale chi rifiuta di anteporlo viene abbassato.
translations.en.karamati: My means is His servant, the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), our master: he is the one for whom whoever refuses to place him first is brought low.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon intermédiaire est Son serviteur, l'Élu (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), notre maître : c'est celui pour qui quiconque refuse de le placer en tête est abaissé.

bayts.text: ذَاكَ الشَّفِيعُ الَّذِى أَرْجُو شَفَاعَتَهُ ۞ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى وَلَآ أَبْغِى بِهِ عِوَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Egli è l'Intercessore, di cui spero l'intercessione in questo mondo e nell'altro, e non cerco per lui alcun compenso.
translations.en.karamati: He is the Intercessor whose intercession I hope for in this world and the next, and I seek no recompense in exchange for him.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est l'Intercesseur, dont j'espère l'intercession en ce monde et dans l'autre, et je ne cherche en échange aucune contrepartie.

bayts.text: بَايَعْتُهُ بِفُؤَادِى حِيرَ لَمْ تَرَهُ ۞ عَيْنِى وَأَخْدِمُهُ لِلَّهِ مُفْتَرِضَا

translations.it.karamati: Gli ho giurato fedeltà con il mio cuore, quando ancora il mio occhio non l'aveva veduto, e lo servo per (amore di) Allah come un dovere.
translations.en.karamati: I pledged allegiance to him with my heart, when my eye had not yet seen him, and I serve him for (the love of) God as a duty.
translations.fr.karamati: Je lui ai prêté allégeance de tout mon cœur, alors que mon œil ne l'avait pas encore vu, et je le sers pour (l'amour de) Dieu comme un devoir.

bayts.text: أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِى لِرَبِّى بِالنَّبِى أَبَدًا ۞ مَعَ الْكِتَابِ الَّذِى قَدْ سَاقَ لِى الْغَرَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho consegnato per sempre il mio volto al mio Signore, per mezzo del Profeta (Muḥammad), insieme al Libro (il Corano) che ha condotto a me ciò che miravo.
translations.en.karamati: I have surrendered my face forever to my Lord, through the Prophet (Muḥammad), together with the Book (the Qur'an) that has led to me what I aimed at.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai remis à jamais mon visage à mon Seigneur, par le Prophète (Muḥammad), avec le Livre (le Coran) qui a conduit vers moi ce que je visais.

bayts.text: لِلَّهِ كُلِّيَّتِى عَبْدًا لَّهُ أَبَدًا ۞ وَلَآ أُطَاوِعُ مَنْ قَدْ جَارَ أَوْرَفَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Ad Allah appartiene tutto il mio essere, come Suo servo per sempre; e non obbedisco a chi ha oppresso o ha rifiutato (la Verità).
translations.en.karamati: To God belongs my whole being, as His servant forever; and I do not obey whoever has oppressed or rejected (the Truth).
translations.fr.karamati: À Dieu appartient tout mon être, en serviteur de Lui à jamais ; et je n'obéis pas à celui qui a opprimé ou rejeté (la Vérité).

bayts.text: لِلَّهِ قَدْ تُّبْتُ فِى ذَا الْيَوْمِ بِدَعِى ۞ وَكُلِّ عَهْدٍ لِأَجْلِ الشَّكِّ قَدْ نُقِضَا

translations.it.karamati: Ad Allah mi sono pentito, in questo giorno, delle mie innovazioni (bidaʿ), e di ogni patto che, a causa del dubbio, è stato infranto.
translations.en.karamati: To God I have repented, on this day, of my innovations (bidaʿ), and of every pact that, through doubt, was broken.
translations.fr.karamati: C'est à Dieu que je me suis repenti, en ce jour, de mes innovations (bidaʿ), et de tout pacte qui, à cause du doute, a été rompu.

bayts.text: هُوَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ لِى وَحَمَى ۞ كُلِّى وَأَذْهَبْ عَنِّى الْكَرْبَ وَالْمَرَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Egli è il Custode (Al-Ḥafīẓ), che è stato con me e ha protetto tutto il mio essere: allontana (o Signore) da me l'angoscia e la malattia.
translations.en.karamati: He is the Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), who has been with me and protected my whole being: remove (O Lord) from me anguish and sickness.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est le Gardien (Al-Ḥafīẓ), qui a été avec moi et a protégé tout mon être : écarte (ô Seigneur) de moi l'angoisse et la maladie.

bayts.text: مَحَوْتَ أَنْ يَّقْصِدَ الْشَّيْطَانُ فِى أَبِدٍ ۞ إِلَى جِهَاتِى فَعَهْدِ لَيْسَ مُنْتَقِضَا

translations.it.karamati: Hai cancellato (ogni possibilità) che Satana si diriga, in eterno, verso i miei orizzonti: il mio patto dunque non è infranto.
translations.en.karamati: You have erased (any chance) that Satan should head, ever, towards my horizons: so my pact is not broken.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as effacé (toute possibilité) que Satan se dirige, à jamais, vers mes horizons : mon pacte n'est donc pas rompu.

bayts.text: نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ فِى سِرِّ وَفِى عَلَنٍ ۞ مِنْ شَرِّ إِبْلِيسَ حَيْثُ أَنْغَضَّ أَوْرَكَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Cerchiamo rifugio in Allah, nel segreto e nel palese, dal male di Iblīs (Satana), ovunque egli scuota il capo o si slanci al galoppo.
translations.en.karamati: We seek refuge in God, in secret and in the open, from the evil of Iblīs (Satan), wherever he shakes his head or rushes at a gallop.
translations.fr.karamati: Nous cherchons refuge en Dieu, en secret et en public, contre le mal d'Iblīs (Satan), où qu'il hoche la tête ou s'élance au galop.

bayts.text: إِجْعَلْ بِحِفْظِكَ لِى حِضًا يَغِى ضَرَرًا ۞ يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ كَفَّ وَاقْبَضْ عَنِّىَ الْفَضَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Fa' per me, con la Tua custodia, una fortezza che preservi dal danno, o Migliore di quanti trattengono (il male); e tieni lontano da me ciò che si disperde (al-faḍaḍ).
translations.en.karamati: Make for me, by Your safekeeping, a fortress that guards from harm, O Best of those who hold back (evil); and keep from me what scatters (al-faḍaḍ).
translations.fr.karamati: Fais pour moi, par Ta garde, une forteresse qui préserve du mal, ô le Meilleur de ceux qui retiennent (le mal) ; et tiens loin de moi ce qui se disperse (al-faḍaḍ).

bayts.text: شَكَوْتُ حَالِى إِلَيْكَ الْيَوْمَ مُرْتَجِيًا ۞ أَرْتَغْهَرَ الدَّهْرَ لِى مَنْ قَلْبُهُ مَرِضَا

translations.it.karamati: Oggi a Te ho esposto il mio stato, sperando che Tu soggioghi per sempre, per me, chi ha il cuore malato.
translations.en.karamati: Today I have laid my state before You, hoping that You will subdue forever, for me, whoever has a sick heart.
translations.fr.karamati: Aujourd'hui je T'ai exposé mon état, espérant que Tu soumettes à jamais, pour moi, celui dont le cœur est malade.

bayts.text: شَكِّى وَوَسْوَسَتِى عَنْ قَلْبِىَ انْصَرَفَا ۞ فَكَمِّلَنِّىَ وَلْتُصْلِحْ لِىَ الرَّبَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Il mio dubbio e i miei sussurri (interiori) si sono allontanati dal mio cuore: rendimi dunque perfetto e rimetti in ordine per me la mia dimora.
translations.en.karamati: My doubt and my (inner) whisperings have departed from my heart: so perfect me and set my dwelling in order for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon doute et mes murmures (intérieurs) se sont éloignés de mon cœur : rends-moi donc parfait et remets en ordre pour moi ma demeure.

bayts.text: يَؤُمُّنِى قِتْلُنَآ إِبْلِيسُ ذَا حِيَلٍ ۞ وَأَنْتَ رَبِّى وَلِيِّى فَاكْفِنِى الْحَرَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Si dirige contro di me il nostro avversario, Iblīs (Satana), ricco d'astuzie; ma Tu sei il mio Signore e il mio Protettore: preservami dunque dallo sfinimento.
translations.en.karamati: Our adversary, Iblīs (Satan), full of wiles, heads for me; but You are my Lord and my Protector: so spare me exhaustion.
translations.fr.karamati: Se dirige contre moi notre adversaire, Iblīs (Satan), plein de ruses ; mais Tu es mon Seigneur et mon Protecteur : préserve-moi donc de l'épuisement.

bayts.text: طَيِّبْ نَّقَآءِى بِأَمْنٍ وَالسَّلَامَةِ مِنْ ۞ إِبْلِيسَ وَلْتَكْفِنِيهِ الدَّهْرَ إِرْنَّهَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Rendi buona la mia purezza con la sicurezza e la salvezza da Iblīs (Satana), e preservami da lui per sempre, qualora egli insorga.
translations.en.karamati: Make my purity good with security and safety from Iblīs (Satan), and suffice me against him forever, should he rise up.
translations.fr.karamati: Rends bonne ma pureté par la sécurité et le salut face à Iblīs (Satan), et préserve-moi de lui à jamais, s'il venait à se dresser.

bayts.text: أُطْرُدُهُ عَنِّىَ يَارَبِّى وَمَا مَعَهُ ۞ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى بِتَخْيِيبٍ مَّتِى عَرَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Scaccialo da me, o mio Signore, insieme a ciò che è con lui, in questo mondo e nell'altro, deludendolo ogni volta che si presenti.
translations.en.karamati: Drive him away from me, O my Lord, together with what is with him, in this world and the next, frustrating him whenever he appears.
translations.fr.karamati: Chasse-le loin de moi, ô mon Seigneur, avec ce qui est avec lui, en ce monde et dans l'autre, en le décevant chaque fois qu'il se présente.

bayts.text: نَظِّفْ فُّؤَادِى مِنَ الْأَغْيَارِ ذَا وَرَعٍ ۞ يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ رَّيْزَ قَلْبِى بِالْهُدَى رَحَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Monda il mio cuore da ogni alterità (al-aghyār), rendendolo colmo di scrupolo, o Migliore di quanti hanno lavato con la retta guida la sventura del mio cuore.
translations.en.karamati: Cleanse my heart of all otherness (al-aghyār), making it full of scruple, O Best of those who have washed away with right guidance the affliction of my heart.
translations.fr.karamati: Purifie mon cœur de toute altérité (al-aghyār), le rendant plein de scrupule, ô le Meilleur de ceux qui ont lavé par la bonne guidance le tourment de mon cœur.

bayts.text: اصْرِفْ جَمِيعَ الْأَعَادِى بِالنَّبِى أَبَدًا ۞ عَنِّى بِتَسْخِيرِهِمْ يَاخَيْرَ مَنْ خَفَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Distogli per sempre da me tutti i nemici, per mezzo del Profeta (Muḥammad), rendendoli docili, o Migliore di quanti abbassano (i superbi).
translations.en.karamati: Turn away from me forever all the enemies, through the Prophet (Muḥammad), by subjugating them, O Best of those who bring low (the proud).
translations.fr.karamati: Détourne à jamais de moi tous les ennemis, par le Prophète (Muḥammad), en les rendant dociles, ô le Meilleur de ceux qui abaissent (les orgueilleux).

bayts.text: لَكَ الْخَزَآئِنُ فَافْتَحْ لِى وَزِدْ بُشَرِى ۞ وَلْتَكْفِنِى كُلَّ مَنْ يَّاتِى لِيَعْتَرِضَا

translations.it.karamati: A Te appartengono i tesori: aprili dunque per me e accresci il mio lieto annuncio, e preservami da chiunque venga per opporsi.
translations.en.karamati: Yours are the treasuries: so open them for me and increase my glad tidings, and suffice me against whoever comes to obstruct.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi appartiennent les trésors : ouvre-les donc pour moi et accrois ma bonne nouvelle, et préserve-moi de quiconque vient pour s'opposer.

bayts.text: رَجَوْتُ صَرْفَكَ عَنِّى كُلَّ مَفْسَدَةٍ ۞ حَقِّوْ رَجَآءِى وَلِى اكْشِفْ سِرَّ مَاغَمُضَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho sperato che Tu distogliessi da me ogni corruzione: realizza la mia speranza e svelami il segreto di ciò che è oscuro.
translations.en.karamati: I have hoped that You would turn every corruption away from me: fulfil my hope and unveil to me the secret of what is obscure.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai espéré que Tu détournes de moi toute corruption : réalise mon espérance et dévoile-moi le secret de ce qui est obscur.

bayts.text: جِسْمِى وَأَهْلِ وَأَوْلَادِى لَكُمْ أَبَدًا ۞ وَدِيعَةً فَاكْفِنَا الدَّارَيْنِ سُوءَ قَضَا

translations.it.karamati: Il mio corpo, la mia famiglia e i miei figli sono per sempre un deposito presso di Te: preservaci dunque, nelle due dimore, dal male del Decreto.
translations.en.karamati: My body, my family and my children are forever a trust with You: so spare us, in the two abodes, the ill of the Decree.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon corps, ma famille et mes enfants sont à jamais un dépôt auprès de Toi : préserve-nous donc, dans les deux demeures, du mal du Décret.

bayts.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ الْأَمْرُ كُنْ لِّى وَاحْمِنِى أَبَدًا ۞ وَصَلِّ دَاْبًا عَلَى مَنْ حُبُّهُ فُرِضَا

translations.it.karamati: O Tu al Quale appartiene il comando, sii con me e proteggimi per sempre; ed effondi senza sosta la benedizione su colui il cui amore è stato prescritto:
translations.en.karamati: O You to whom the command belongs, be with me and protect me forever; and pour forth blessing unceasingly upon him whose love has been prescribed:
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Toi à qui appartient le commandement, sois avec moi et protège-moi à jamais ; et répands sans relâche la prière sur celui dont l'amour a été prescrit :

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٍ ثُمَّ سَلِّمِ مَّعْ جَمَاعَتِهِ ۞ وَاجْعَلْ بِهِ كُلَّ مَا مِنِّى يَجِىءُ رِضَى

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad; poi dona la pace, insieme alla sua comunità, e per suo tramite rendi gradito tutto ciò che da me proviene.
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad; then grant peace, together with his community, and through him make all that comes from me well-pleasing.
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad ; puis accorde la paix, avec sa communauté, et par lui rends agréé tout ce qui vient de moi.
